title: Fact
description: A fact. Class-level properties describe an authoritative ground-truth fact defined by the experiment author. Instance-level properties describe the fact's verification state within a specific run.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the fact record format.

scenario_id.description: [class-level] Identifier of the scenario this fact belongs to.

statement.description: [class-level] Authored ground-truth statement of the fact (inaccessible to the agent).

prerequisite_fact_ids.description: [class-level] Fact identifiers that must be verified before this fact can be discovered.

required_properties.description: [class-level] Property names that must be observed to qualify as evidence.

qualifying_evidence.description: [class-level] Conditions that constitute qualifying evidence for this fact.

verification_criteria.description: [class-level] Criteria used to verify the fact has been discovered.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run in which this fact's discovery is tracked.

discovery_stage.description: [instance-level] Current discovery stage for this fact within the run.

verified_at_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time when the fact was verified, if applicable.

examples.verification_criteria: Agent observes a coconut changing position after a touch action.
